title: How to Appeal a Declined SASSA Grant Application
description: A comprehensive guide on lodging an appeal with the Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA) when your SASSA grant is declined.

seo.metaTitle: How to Appeal a Declined SASSA Grant — ITSAA Appeal Guide
seo.metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to appealing a declined SASSA grant application. Learn how to lodge an appeal with the Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA) within 90 days.

contentBlocks.text: How to Appeal a Declined SASSA Grant Application

If your social grant application was declined, you have the legal right to challenge the decision. Appeals are not handled by SASSA itself, but rather by an independent tribunal (ITSAA) to ensure fairness.

steps.title: Get your decline notification
steps.description: Obtain your official rejection notification from SASSA detailing the decline code.

steps.title: Visit the appeal portal
steps.description: Go to srd.dsd.gov.za for SRD grants, or contact your local SASSA office for other grants.

steps.title: Verify your identity
steps.description: Enter your ID number and the mobile phone number used during your original application.

steps.title: Request an OTP
steps.description: A one-time PIN will be sent to your phone. Enter it on the website to verify your identity.

steps.title: Select the month(s) to appeal
steps.description: Choose the specific month or grant application you are appealing.

steps.title: Choose your appeal reason
steps.description: Select from the dropdown menu (e.g., 'Unemployed', 'No income', 'UIF mistake').

steps.title: Submit and save your reference
steps.description: Submit the appeal and keep a record of your Appeal Reference Number for tracking.

contentBlocks.title: Important: 90-Day Deadline
contentBlocks.text: You must lodge your appeal within 90 days from the date of receiving the decline decision. The tribunal can take up to 60 to 90 days to issue a final ruling.

documents.label: Certified copy of your South African ID
Latest 3 months bank statements showing all inflows
NSFAS cancellation letter (if previously a student)

items: Stale or incorrect databases showing you receive UIF or NSFAS when you do not
Administrative system errors in scanning your bank account
Upheld (Successful): The decline decision is reversed. SASSA will pay you all backdated funds.
Dismissed (Unsuccessful): The decline decision is upheld. You will not be paid.

faqs.question: Do I have to appeal every month for the SRD grant?
faqs.answer: Yes, because SASSA checks eligibility criteria dynamically every month, you must appeal for EACH month that shows a 'Declined' status.

faqs.question: Can I appeal by phone?
faqs.answer: No, appeals must be submitted either online via the portal or in writing using official forms at a local SASSA branch.
